intent: Implement IngressPacket (Java 21, Spring Boot 3, WebFlux/Reactor/R2DBC, constructor injection, no blocking calls) so that the frozen test passes, providing exactly the ast_hints table and nothing improvised. Unit contract: Context Telemetry Ingestion & Validation. Immutable record Ingress Packet: the raw payload from a device carrying one or more Telemetry Samples. Invariants: non-null components, non-blank deviceId, at least one sample (IllegalArgumentException otherwise), unmodifiable copy of the sample list.

methods.signature: IngressPacket(String deviceId, SourceKind sourceKind, List<TelemetrySample> samples)
methods.semantics: Null rejected (NullPointerException); deviceId non-blank; samples non-empty and defensively copied into an unmodifiable list.
